assignments.reason: This is a variant spelling of אריכות ימים (already in Pkg 1). The node text explicitly states: 'נִמְשָׁךְ אֲרִיכוּת הַיָּמִים, בְּחִינַת זָקֵן, בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּנֵי עַתִּיק'. Its essential nature IS the extension of days — the core concept of the yirah/zaken/Atik domain. It appears as a cause-node leading to wealth flowing into extended days (edge 16) and as an effect of yirah (edge 0).

The 'hitkashrut' (bonding/engagement) referenced here is the bonding of the marriage partners (section ח, line 65: 'שְׁבִירַת כְּלֵי חֶרֶס שֶׁשּׁוֹבְרִין בִּשְׁעַת הִתְקַשְּׁרוּת הַזִּוּוּגִים'). Its essential nature is the marital bonding that leads to birth — the ritual/relational act within the speech-birth nexus. It produces holy bitachon (בטחון דקדשה), and the engagement/bonding IS a dimension of the holy union that enables הולדה.

Holy trust/bitachon (בטחון דקדשה) is the sanctified form of בטחון already in Pkg 2. The Rebbe states (line 65-66) that the hitkashrut produces בטחון דקדשה which is the opposite of the sitra achra's bitachon. Its essential nature is the holy dimension of the birth-vessels (כלי הולדה = בטחון = כליות), which is the core domain of Pkg 2.

assignments.node_id: שיהיה למודו, ללמד וללמד ולשמר ולעשות. דהינו שעל־ידי למודו עם תלמידו, יהיה כאלו עשאו לחברו, וכאלו עשאו לדברי תורה. כמו שאמרו רבותינו, זכרונם לברכה (סנהדרין צ"ט:): כל המלמד בן חברו תורה, כאלו עשאו וכו, וכאלו עשאו לדברי תורה וכו. וכשלומד בכונה זו
assignments.reason: This node describes the specific intention of learning Torah with a student — 'to learn and to teach and to guard and to do, as if making the student and making the Torah itself.' Its essential nature is the sacred act of Torah transmission through speech to students. The Rebbe explicitly connects this to כתיבה (writing on the student's heart, line 56-57) and to the protection mechanism of שיחת תלמידי חכמים. Since כשלומד עם אחר and כתיבה are already in Pkg 2, and this node describes the same domain of holy speech-transmission, it belongs in Pkg 2.

assignments.node_id: השם יתברך שומר אותו, שלא יהיו דבריו נכתבין בכח הזכרון של התלמיד שאינו הגון, רק יהיו נשכחין ממנו.
assignments.reason: This node describes God's protection that causes the unworthy student to FORGET the Torah words. Its essential nature is the mechanism of holy forgetting — the positive deployment of שכחה as a protective force. While it is a GOOD outcome (God protects the teacher), the mechanism itself operates through שכחה (forgetting) and שבירת הלוחות (the words are erased from the unworthy heart-tablets). The Rebbe explicitly connects this to Eruvin 54: 'if the first tablets had not been broken, there would be no forgetting' (line 71). Since שכחה, שבירת הלב, and שבירת הלוחות are the core of Pkg 5, and this node describes the controlled, sanctified form of that same forgetting-mechanism, it belongs in Pkg 5. Polarity is good because here the forgetting serves a protective holy purpose.

assignments.node_id: להתיר פה אלמים להתיר פה עקרות
assignments.reason: This is a combined node joining the two core outcomes of the speech-birth nexus: releasing the mute (להתיר פה אלמים, already in Pkg 2) and releasing the barren (להתיר פה עקרות, already in Pkg 2). Its essential nature is the unified speech-birth act — the Torah's central conclusion that releasing speech and releasing birth are one process. The Rebbe derives this from Sanhedrin 100: 'ועלהו לתרופה — להתיר פה אלמים ולהתיר פה עקרות' (line 60). Belongs in Pkg 2 as the summary expression of the speech-birth domain.

assignments.node_id: להרחיב ולהאריך ימיו בתוספות קדשה בכל פעם
assignments.reason: This node describes the process of 'expanding and extending one's days with additional holiness at every moment' — the very definition of אריכות ימים in this Torah (line 13-14). Its essential nature IS the extension of days through progressive sanctification, which is the core mechanism of the yirah/zaken domain. It is an effect of יראה (edge 9) and semantically identical to the central concept of Pkg 1.

Eating (אכילה) is described in the Torah as a neutral act that can go either way: eating in holiness and purity produces לחם הפנים (showbread = face/intellect restored), while eating impure food causes the face/sekhel to be lost and one falls into שנה (sleep). The Rebbe says (line 42-43): 'כשאוכל בקדשה ובטהרה אזי הוא בחינת לחם הפנים'. Eating is an action/medium, not inherently of any single package's nature. However, its essential domain in this Torah is the mechanism for maintaining the face/sekhel/panim — which is the intellectual-contemplation axis of Pkg 1. The Choni story centers eating as the trigger for sleep (line 91: 'כָּרֵךְ רִפְתָּא, אַתְיָא לֵהּ שִׁינְתָא'). Since the panim/sekhel/hitbonenut domain is Pkg 1, and eating is the key instrument for maintaining or losing that domain, it belongs in Pkg 1 as a neutral mechanism.

The showbread (לחם הפנים) is the face-bread — eating in holiness IS the showbread (line 43: 'כשאוכל בקדשה ובטהרה אזי הוא בחינת לחם הפנים'). Its essential nature is the sanctified sustenance that preserves the face/sekhel/panim. Since the face (פנים = שכל = חכמת אדם תאיר פניו) is the intellectual-contemplation axis, and the contemplation/hitbonenut domain is the core of Pkg 1, לחם הפנים belongs in Pkg 1 as the nourishment-dimension of the panim/sekhel.

'This wealth' (לעשירות הזאת) refers to the specific wealth needed for hitbonenut (line 12: 'ולבוא לעשירות הזאת הוא על ידי בחינת תקוני עתיק, בחינת אריכות ימים, בחינת זקן'). Its essential nature is the same as עשירות (already in Pkg 1) — the wealth that flows through the Atik/zaken/yirah chain to enable Torah contemplation. It is an effect of תקוני עתיק, אריכות ימים, and זקן (edges 11-13), all of which are Pkg 1 nodes.

This node describes the action of 'subduing the vanity of beauty' — the direct effect of יראה on the evil domain (edge 14, line 78: 'יראה מכניע את הבל היפי'). Its essential nature is the triumph of yirah over the evil breath-domain. While it references הבל היפי (Pkg 4), the act of subduing is an expression of yirah's protective power. The subjugation IS yirah in action. Belongs in Pkg 1 as the active, conquering dimension of fear of God.

Stories/tales (ספורי מעשיות) are the primary instrument of awakening in this Torah. The additions file already identifies סיפורי מעשיות as belonging to Pkg 2 (the speech-awakening domain). The Rebbe says (line 46): 'כשרוצין להראות לו פניו ולעוררו משנתו, צריכין להלביש לו את הפנים בסיפורי מעשיות'. The stories ARE the clothing of the face — the speech-act that restores speech to the sleeping. This is distinct from 'ספורי מעשיות של שנים קדמוניות' (ancient stories, in Pkg 1 as the Atik dimension). Plain 'ספורי מעשיות' is the general act of story-telling-as-awakening, which belongs in the speech-birth-awakening domain of Pkg 2.

'Awakening from sleep' (מעוררין מהשנה) is the core action of the awakening process described throughout sections ו-ט. Pkg 2 is labeled 'דבור, הולדה והתעוררות' — Speech, Birth, and Awakening. The node התעוררות השנה (awakening of sleep) is already in Pkg 1 as a bechina of שופר. However, מעוררין מהשנה is the EFFECT of the stories — it is the act of being awakened, which is the immediate precursor to speech-release (להתיר פה אלמים) and birth (פקידות עקרות). Its essential nature is the awakening-act itself, which is the domain of Pkg 2 (the active process of restoring speech and birth).

'Wealth is drawn into the extension of days' — this is the culminating result of the entire Torah's positive chain (line 99: 'נמשך העשירות לתוך האריכות ימים'). Its essential nature is the fusion of עשירות and אריכות ימים — both core Pkg 1 concepts. It is caused by אריכות הימים, זקן, and תקוני עתיק (edges 16-18), all Pkg 1 nodes. Belongs in Pkg 1 as the summary-outcome of the yirah/zaken/wealth chain.

assignments.node_id: שמעורר בני אדם משנתם על־ידי ספורי מעשיות
assignments.reason: 'The one who awakens people from their sleep through stories' — this is the description of the tzaddik/sage who performs the awakening act (line 60: 'שמעורר בני אדם משנתם על ידי ספורי מעשיות'). Its essential nature is the speech-act of the sage that produces the release of the mute (edge 19: → נעשה בחינת להתיר פה אלמים). Since the awakening-through-speech process is the core of Pkg 2, this node belongs there.

'The aspect of releasing the mute is achieved' — this is the outcome-node describing the accomplishment of speech-release. Its essential nature is identical to להתיר פה אלמים (already in Pkg 2). It is the effect of the awakening-through-stories (edge 19). Belongs in Pkg 2.

assignments.node_id: כששיחתו היא בבחינת שיחת תלמידי־חכמים צריכין למוד, הינו ללמד וללמד לשמר ולעשות כנ"ל,
assignments.reason: 'When his speech is in the aspect of the conversation of Torah scholars that requires study, namely to learn and teach and guard and do' — this describes the quality of the sage's speech-act when it achieves protection from unworthy students. Its essential nature is qualified, intentional Torah speech — the highest form of the speech-awakening process. Since שיחת תלמידי חכמים is the mode of the awakening speech, and the speech domain is Pkg 2, this belongs in Pkg 2.

'Being guarded from unworthy students' — this is the protective outcome for the sage who teaches with the proper intention. Its essential nature is the holy safeguard of the speech-transmission process. The Rebbe describes this (line 55-57) as the protection God gives to the teacher so that his words are not 'written' (כתיבה) on impure vessels. Since כתיבה and כשלומד עם אחר are in Pkg 2, and this node describes the protection of that same transmission process, it belongs in Pkg 2.

'They awaken people from their sleep' — a variant of שמעורר בני אדם משנתם על ידי ספורי מעשיות, this is the general statement of the awakening act (line 40). It causes פקידות עקרות (edge 26). Its essential nature is the awakening process that leads to birth — the core of Pkg 2.

Money/wealth (ממון) is explicitly decoded by the Rebbe (line 11): 'אותיות ממון ראשי תבות: משם נתעשר משה' — the letters of ממון are an acronym for 'from there Moshe became wealthy' (from the tablets). Its essential nature is identical to עשירות (already in Pkg 1) — it is the wealth required for hitbonenut. It causes the paths of Torah contemplation (edge 27). Belongs in Pkg 1.

assignments.node_id: שבילי התורה, שיש בהם התבוננות גדול מאד.
assignments.reason: 'The paths of Torah in which there is very great contemplation' — this is the opening concept of the entire Torah (line 5): 'דע שיש שבילי התורה שיש בהם התבוננות גדול מאד'. Its essential nature is Torah contemplation (hitbonenut), which is the ultimate purpose of the entire yirah → zaken → wealth chain. Hitbonenut is what the wealth enables, and the wealth flows through the Atik/zaken domain. Belongs in Pkg 1 as the telos of the yirah-wealth axis.

assignments.node_id: שומרת מההפך של עשירות, דהינו עניות,
assignments.reason: 'Guards from the opposite of wealth, namely poverty' — this describes יראה's protective function against poverty (line 17: 'היראה שומרת מההפך של עשירות דהינו עניות'). While it references עניות (poverty, associated with Pkg 4's evil domain), the node's essential nature is the protective action of yirah. It is an effect of יראה (edge 28). The guarding IS yirah's function within its own domain. Belongs in Pkg 1.

'Guard the openings of your mouth' (Micah 7:5) — the Rebbe interprets this (line 67) as the requirement for guarding one's speech so that the bitachon/birth-vessels are properly connected to speech. Its essential nature is the discipline of holy speech that enables the speech-birth connection. Since it causes the joining of bitachon and dibur (edge 29), and the speech-birth nexus is Pkg 2, this belongs in Pkg 2.

assignments.node_id: שיהיה הבטחון, הינו כלי ההולדה, סמוכין אל הדבור, שהוא בחינת אלף שהוא ראשי־תבות להתיר פה אלמים. וזה: משכבת חיקך, הינו שיהיה נעשה מזה הולדה. וזה: משכבת חיקך, בחינת (מלכים־א א): "ושכבה בחיקך"
assignments.reason: This lengthy node describes the joining of bitachon (birth-vessels) with dibur (speech) to produce holada (birth). It references בטחון, כלי הולדה, דבור, and להתיר פה אלמים — all core Pkg 2 concepts. Its essential nature is the complete speech-birth mechanism: guarding speech → speech-vessels connect to birth-vessels → birth occurs. This is the structural summary of Pkg 2's entire domain.
